messages.author: a387d7985c232d82
messages.subject: Expectation Failure
parts:
Hello all,

I recently installed rstan on a new machine and encountered a mysterious "expectation failure" error, which can be reproduced as follows:

> oxford <- stan_demo("oxford")
> "K" <- 
+ 120
> "r1" <-
+ c(3, 5, 2, 7, 7, 2, 5, 3, 5, 11, 6, 6, 11, 4, 4, 2, 8, 8, 6, 
+ 5, 15, 4, 9, 9, 4, 12, 8, 8, 6, 8, 12, 4, 7, 16, 12, 9, 4, 7, 
.... [TRUNCATED] 
> "n1" <-
+ c(28, 21, 32, 35, 35, 38, 30, 43, 49, 53, 31, 35, 46, 53, 61, 
+ 40, 29, 44, 52, 55, 61, 31, 48, 44, 42, 53, 56, 71, 43, 43, 43,  .... [TRUNCATED] 

> "r0" <-
+ c(0, 2, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 4, 4, 2, 1, 7, 4, 3, 5, 3, 2, 
+ 4, 1, 4, 5, 2, 7, 5, 8, 2, 3, 5, 4, 1, 6, 5, 11, 5, 2, 5, 8, 
 .... [TRUNCATED] 

> "n0" <-
+ c(28, 21, 32, 35, 35, 38, 30, 43, 49, 53, 31, 35, 46, 53, 61, 
+ 40, 29, 44, 52, 55, 61, 31, 48, 44, 42, 53, 56, 71, 43, 43, 43,  .... [TRUNCATED] 

> "year" <-
+ c(-10, -9, -9, -8, -8, -8, -7, -7, -7, -7, -6, -6, -6, -6, -6, 
+ -5, -5, -5, -5, -5, -5, -4, -4, -4, -4, -4, -4, -4, -3, -3, - .... [TRUNCATED] 

TRANSLATING MODEL 'oxford' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
Error in stanc(file = file, model_code = model_code, model_name = model_name,  : 
  failed to parse Stan model 'oxford' with error message:
EXPECTATION FAILURE LOCATION: file=input; line=38, column=2

}
 ^-- here


DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
Parser expecting: <model declaration>


Any thoughts on what might be going on? I am using rstan Version 2.2.0 and R version 3.1.0 on Mac OS X 10.9.2. Thanks for your help!

Devin
